description: Answers a plain-language question about this directory's listings, e.g. 'invoice approval tools with SSO and a free trial', with up to 10 matching products as schema.org records (review page, official site, CTI score and a visit link). It is the same answer as the site's NLWeb /ask address. No model runs: the words are matched against the listings, so short questions with the words that matter work best. Results are matches, not a ranking or a recommendation.

examples: writing assistants with SSO and a free trial

name: ask_site
title: Ask this directory a question
